name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
policyReason: Pets stay on paved areas; no cavern, unpaved trails or visitor center, and a day kennel is available.
summary: Pets stay on paved areas; no cavern, unpaved trails or visitor center, and a day kennel is available.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed in the cavern, on unpaved park trails on the surface, off road, during the Bat Flight Program, or in the visitor center.

dogRules.text: Not in the cavern, on unpaved trails, off road, at the Bat Flight Program or in the visitor center.
No leaving pets in vehicles; use the kennel.
A concession day kennel holds pets while you tour the cavern.
